versions.subject: feat: more updates
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Description|contains: '7-Zip'
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\7z.exe'
        - '\7zr.exe'
        - '\7za.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - '7z.exe'
        - '7za.exe'
selection_password:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -p'
        - ' x '
        - ' -o'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Description="*7-Zip*" OR Image IN ("*\\7z.exe", "*\\7zr.exe", "*\\7za.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("7z.exe", "7za.exe") CommandLine IN ("* -p*", "* x *", "* -o*")
